https://www.tesla.com/careers/adas-validation-12345

ADAS Validation Engineer
Palo Alto, CA (on-site)

About the role:
Join the Autopilot validation team to verify Level 2 ADAS behavior across our
commercial and passenger platforms.

Responsibilities:
- Validate Smart Cruise Control (SCC) and Adaptive Cruise Control behavior across driving scenarios.
- Build and run Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) test benches.
- Analyze target selection robustness using BEV log replay through production logic.
- Debug false detections during on-vehicle testing at our proving grounds.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in ADAS or autonomous driving validation.
- Strong Python and C++ scripting for log analysis.
- Hands-on experience with CANape and CAN-FD.
- Working knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety.
- Must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with scenario-based testing and CARLA simulation.
- Experience with dynamometer and real-vehicle validation.
